messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: runtime replica-3 high GPU mem pressure -> OOMs. Auto-attached logs and top summary.
oncall-anna: taking this, SRE oncall. tagging for live mitigation.

darren: quick snapshot from 15:01-15:06 window:
```
GPU0 replica-3: total=48GB used=46.2GB alloc=34.7GB kv_cache=9.6GB slabs=1.9GB
GPU1 replica-1: total=48GB used=11.0GB alloc=9.8GB kv_cache=0.9GB slabs=0.3GB
OOM observed on replica-3 @ 2024-11-09T15:02:18Z
```

ml-runner: model=redwood-v1-8b-qat, batch_size=8, seq=2048. We were replaying kafka spike.
sre-tom: hyp-1: routing hot-key concentration on replica-3 leading to kv cache hotchain. hyp-2: batch growth + slow eviction under sustained prefix churn.
oncall-anna: mitigation plan (immediate): 1) reduce batch_size to 4 on replica-3, 2) enable aggressive kv eviction, 3) route 25% traffic away from replica-3 to replica-2.

eng-ryan: applying batch change now ->
```
PATCH /runtime/replicas/replica-3/config
{ "model.batch_size": 4 }
```
eng-ryan: applied, confirmed to replica-3 (rolling true).

ml-runner: toggling `kv.eviction.mode=aggressive` and `kv.eviction.threshold=0.65`.
sre-tom: toggled, watching metrics.

darren: metrics after changes (3m post):
```
GPU0 used=33.4GB kv_cache=5.9GB requests/s=360 (was 420)
No further OOMs in 9m.
```

support-ellie: checking customer impact: this was staging load test (kafka-replay). No prod customers impacted. Marking customer-impact: none.
oncall-anna: good. Marking incident severity reduced to P1. Starting RCA artifacts collection: alloc traces, per-request kv keys, timeline.

ml-runner: uploaded artifacts -> s3://redwood-stage-logs/rca/1768765432/ (contains `alloc-trace.gz`, `kv-chain-dump.jsonl`, `request-trace-15-02-18.tar`). Also copied to /tmp/rca/1768765432.tar.gz on staging node.

eng-ryan: reproducer command for engineering:
```
./stress-run --replay=staging/replays/spike-2024-11-09.json --concurrency=220 --target=replica-3 --batch=8
```
Goal: reproduce OOM with original config to validate fix.

sre-tom: tagging postmortem owner: eng-ryan, reviewers: darren, ml-runner, oncall-anna. Creating PM ticket PM-INC-2024-1768765432.

oncall-anna: RCA notes to collect: allocator churn rates, slab fragmentation histograms, kv eviction latencies, per-prefix request distribution, cross-replica routing logs.

darren: initial observations: kv_chain traces show repeated insertions for a small set of prefixes causing chain lengths > 120 and blocking LRU. Also saw increased allocator free list fragmentation.

eng-ryan: adding short-term follow-ups: (A) introduce per-prefix request-rate throttles, (B) add per-replica kv hot-key backpressure, (C) evaluate proactive kv compaction and shard autoscale.

ml-runner: test plan: rerun replay with batch_size=4 and aggressive eviction to validate stability, then replay batch_size=8 to confirm repro. Will attach VM traces.
support-ellie: please confirm in doc that no downstream alerts were triggered for customers. I'll attach timestamped confirmation.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated. mitigation_notes="reduced batch_size on replica-3, aggressive eviction enabled, 25% traffic rerouted" responders=[oncall-anna, eng-ryan, sre-tom]

oncall-anna: closing live mitigation handoff. Postmortem timeline owner: eng-ryan. If anyone observes resurgence reopen thread.

eng-ryan: note for postmortem: consider tuning default kv.eviction.threshold and adding a canary test for replay spikes. Will include memory heatmaps and allocation timelines in PM.
sre-tom: will follow up with a short-term patch to route hot-key prefixes evenly across replicas.
support-ellie: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
